enabled_by: FASTLIVO_BOUNDARY_TIMING=1 and normal diagnostic logger enabled
rate: At most one row per >=1 monotonic wall second per instrumented thread, emitted when a scope completes; final partial period is not emitted
header: raw record, sequence=0, source stamp is latest logger context (not independent callback timestamp); source not used by estimator

boundary_labels.1: UndistortPcl whole (includes IMU propagation and backward deskew)
boundary_labels.4: LIO StateEstimation whole (includes residual query and algebra)
boundary_labels.7: publication conversion/enqueue calls including navigation cloud

inclusions: Nested intervals overlap; cannot add boundaries as exclusive total. CPU process includes OpenMP workers, DDS and writer threads; per-boundary process CPU is concurrent process activity, not exclusive function work. Thread CPU counts only current caller. Completion-window totals may include outer scopes whose start preceded window begin. Spin_some includes callback work and serialization/queueing; DDS work after return is outside synchronous publish wall. Logger enqueue/time itself not part of finished scope. No individual point payload allocation, no estimator state copy. Timer-disabled Scope only checks bool, performs no clock_gettime or row copy.
